title: Hog Quest
tagline: A tiny office RPG, by PostHog

music.mood: cosy, curious, gentle exploration, warm office afternoon

text.win: Every problem solved, and not a single user harmed. The team goes home early.
text.lose: The problems won this round. Grab a coffee and stay determined.
text.credits: Made with PostHog. Music and art generated locally.

intro: You arrive at Your Company HQ. It smells like coffee and unresolved tickets.
Somewhere in this office, four problems are hiding. Time to go say hi.

rooms.name: Reception
rooms.description: Plants, a couch, and a suspicious hum.

rooms.name: Server Closet
rooms.description: It is warm in here. Too warm.

rooms.name: Big Meeting Room
rooms.description: The roadmap lives here. So does the boss.

npcs.name: Sam
lines: Welcome! Sign in, grab a badge, mind the bug by the door.
It's been blocking the hallway since the last release.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a friendly receptionist with a headset and a cardigan

npcs.name: Priya
lines: The error only happens in production. Only on Tuesdays.
If only we could SEE what users actually did...
npcs.sprite_prompt: a software engineer with round glasses and a hoodie

npcs.name: Leo
lines: We shipped the feature. Did anyone use it? Nobody knows.
I have a spreadsheet. It has feelings now.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a product manager holding a coffee mug and a notebook

npcs.name: Dana
lines: Every day: 'can you just pull one quick number?'
One quick number. Forty SQL queries.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a data engineer with headphones and a striped shirt

npcs.name: Max
lines: The Monolith has been here longer than I have.
Be gentle. It holds up the whole company.
npcs.sprite_prompt: a tired CTO in a blazer holding a laptop

enemies.name: Flaky Test
enemies.pain: Passes locally, fails in CI. Every time.
enemies.intro: Flaky Test blocks the doorway! It passed yesterday.
talk: You ask what it needs. It says 'more retries'. You say no.
You tell it about deterministic seeds. It looks interested.
enemies.solve_line: The stack trace shows the race condition. Flaky Test finally feels seen.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a jittery one-eyed bug blob with a red checkmark on its belly

enemies.name: Silent Error
enemies.intro: Silent Error appears! It says nothing. That's the problem.
talk: You ask what went wrong. It shrugs in 500 status codes.
You promise not to blame it. It whispers a stack trace.
enemies.solve_line: You replay the checkout. There it is: the button that does nothing.
enemies.sprite_prompt: an angry little error dialog window with X eyes and stubby legs

enemies.name: Scope Creep
enemies.intro: Scope Creep drifts in with 'one small request'.
talk: You ask what it really wants. It lists nine things.
You suggest shipping one thing first. It sighs, relieved.
enemies.solve_line: Ship the small version behind a flag. Scope Creep shrinks to a sensible size.
enemies.sprite_prompt: a sleepy fog cloud surrounded by floating question marks

boss.name: Legacy Monolith
boss.pain: Nobody knows what it does. Everybody depends on it.
boss.intro: The Legacy Monolith boots up. Its fans spin like jet engines.
talk: You ask how it is doing. It replies in COBOL.
You say it did a great job for fifteen years. It hums softly.
You promise it a well-earned retirement. It dims its lights.
boss.solve_line: The dashboard shows which parts people actually use. Most of it can rest now.
boss.sprite_prompt: a hulking old server rack monster with glowing yellow eyes and cable legs
boss.taunt: I have been in production since 2009. You cannot refactor me!

ending: The Monolith powers down, peacefully. The office goes quiet.
Then someone opens a dashboard, and everyone can finally see what's going on.
ending_pacifist: Every problem was spared. The Monolith retires to a nice server farm by the sea.
The team opens one dashboard, and for once, everyone agrees on what it says.
ending_bugfix: Every problem was debugged the hard way. The office is very, very quiet.
The bugs are gone. So is the context. Someone opens a dashboard to find out what happened.
